limitations: June–August2026 as-filed submission batch, not all managers, securities or current holdings.
Manager CIKs identify reporting institutions, not held-security issuers; do not add them to issuer coverage.
Amendments, restatements, added holdings, report periods and confidential-omission context are preserved separately; rows are not deduplicated current positions.
VALUE in this source is reported dollars, not thousands; amounts remain exact source text with shares/principal, options and voting/discretion context. No aggregate portfolio value is computed.
CUSIPs are source strings, not verified ticker/issuer mappings. Holdings are delayed, may concern old periods, and are not purchase/sale transactions or investment signals.
Conflicting amendment flags are preserved in a private validation table, not automatically reconciled.
Raw holdings, addresses, phone numbers and signatures remain private; only coverage aggregates are published.
Browser status and exact download clock unavailable; local verification time is not first-public evidence.
